{{Quote|It has come to my attention that there is a cave filled with many inbred rancors. These creatures must be destroyed before they spread their line. Are you ready for your task?|a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] rancor tamer, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aNrt" />}}
The '''Mutant Rancor Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:aNrt" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mutant Rancor Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:aNrt" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
